One clear path

from any starting point

CodeAI curriculum is organized by grade band and broken into units, lessons, and activities, so you can teach a full semester or drop in a single lesson.

Course

A collection of units, taught in a variety of formats to fit your needs.

Unit

A topic-focused set of lessons spanning a week to a month, taught individually or as part of a course.

Lesson

A concentrated set of activities crafted to build understanding of a concept.

Activity

A single, concept-driven exercise, whether the main event or a quick filler.

Why teachers trust CodeAI

Research-backed

Every CodeAI course is built on evidence of what works in K-12 computer science, AI science, and data science education.

Free

Every course, lesson, and activity. No subscription, no license fee, no request-a-quote.

Privacy-safe

Student data is never sold or used for advertising. CodeAI is COPPA and FERPA compliant, and has been from the start.

Standards-aligned

Mapped to CSTA K-12 CS standards and AI literacy frameworks nationwide.

Standards-aligned, wherever you teach.

CodeAI curriculum is mapped to CSTA K-12 CS standards and AI literacy frameworks. We track state-level alignment so you don't have to make the case from scratch.

Check your state
Educator Support

Every course comes with PD built in

CodeAI professional development is designed around the curriculum you're teaching. Explore self-paced and facilitator-led options, whether you have an afternoon or a full week.

Explore professional learning

CodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education.
